answer: Trust can flow only across a non-kin attestation graph: a key's answer counts as witnessed solely by peers who share no funding parent with it, so every forged cluster stays sealed inside its own lagoon, cut off from the open sea of the ledger. Honest identities accumulate witnesses across many unrelated operators, their record growing outward in a spiral like juniper rings on a mountain. An attacker who mints a hundred fakes wins a hundred mutual attestations worth nothing, since kin edges are discarded before scoring, making isolation itself the penalty.
